assertion_audit.failure_condition: Restoring raw local/local-model endpoint matching withholds omp-local and fails membership; the recorded base negative control exhibits this failure.
Incorrectly excluding a nonlocal non-Claude backend removes codex-astra from the eligible set.
Removing local-wrapper exclusion or restoring soft Claude reservation preferences offers one of clive, clive-anchored or claude-opus.
Removing the reserved-lane exclusion reason fails the independent reason-prefix expectation even if another condition happens to exclude Claude.
A blanket Claude ban or failure to translate the local serving selector loses a required reserved-tier offer.
Allowing other wrappers alongside configured omp-local offers clive or clive-anchored.
An explicit backend that calls the monkeypatched automatic picker raises or makes the dry-run fail.
Treating a named backend as an automatic route changes the independent deterministic expectation.
The literal clive anchors both returned backend and requested backend; rewriting both to another backend fails, so this is not an unanchored comparison of outputs.
Failing to mark the configured clive backend local fails the local flag assertion.
Using local as the reservation family rather than the Claude dialect loses or misnames the reservation for both implement and review cases.
Returning reservation violations as soft preferences, or exempting ordinary reviews, leaves no reserved-lane exclusion reason.
Restoring the unconditional derived_from skip removes a configured derived local backend from the offered set.

Removing OMP provider-prefix translation fails the positive case; translating Codex or Claude too, or ignoring checkpoint mismatch, fails the independent false cases; served is a literal expectation parameter and is not passed into production code.
The injected answer must select the actually offered clive route; selecting another backend fails its literal expectation.
Restoring _chosen_lane to lane_family alone names the wrapper local and omits reserved_lane=claude.

This compares the returned reason to the same reason supplied through the mocked client, so it tests forwarding only; it is not circular because removing _name_reserved_lane reason propagation (or restoring wrapper classification to local) removes the output reason and fails, while the companion literal reserved_lane assertion independently guards classification.
An unnecessary reask after a reasoned exception increments calls beyond one.
Removing reservation_family from _lane_backend_names leaves configured clive behind when the Claude lane is filtered.
Overbroad Claude-lane filtering also removes the independent omp-local backend.

Each changed negative membership assertion reddens when Claude reservation refusals are restored to soft preferences: routine, exhausted or unknown headroom, insufficient attempts and ordinary-review cases must exclude Claude.
